overview_description.description:
Mortgages help borrowers become homeowners. Yet, closing a mortgage is a complex transaction that requires multiple participants, processes, and technology. Borrowers are thrown into an intricate, stressful process instead of feeling excited and confident about this meaningful investment. And the teams responsible for delivering the loan should feel empowered to close efficiently. To improve both borrower experience and business outcomes, lenders and title companies operating at the center of the closing need the right tools—which is why we built Snapdocs.

Snapdocs is the leading digital closing solution connecting the people, processes, and technologies that power mortgage closings. Our platform automates every interaction between lenders and title companies across the mortgage closing process, from pre-closing through the sale of the loan. With our patented AI technology, hands-on customer service, and extensive settlement and notary networks, all mortgage participants enjoy accurate, smooth, and secure closings. This approach gives customers a competitive advantage by saving them time and money. Snapdocs makes mortgage a snap. For more information, please visit www.snapdocs.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Snapdocs is the mortgage industry’s leading digital closing technology provider, automating the interactions between lenders & settlement.

product.name: eClosing
product.description: A digital closing platform that standardizes and automates mortgage loan closings across all types, enabling borrowers to preview and eSign documents and complete closings efficiently.

product.name: eVault
product.description: A secure digital vault for storing, managing, and transferring electronic promissory notes (eNotes) designed specifically for mortgage lenders and secondary market participants.

product.name: Notary Connect
product.description: A platform that connects lenders, title companies, and signing services to a large network of credentialed mobile notaries for scheduling and managing mortgage signings.

product.name: Quality Control
product.description: An AI-powered automated file review system that accelerates mortgage loan quality control by providing instant and accurate document checks.

product.name: POS Integrations
product.description: Integration services that connect Snapdocs’ digital closing platform with various Point of Sale (POS) systems to enable seamless borrower access to closing tasks within their mortgage application workflow.
